rationale: A common clinical myth is that directly asking about suicidal thoughts 'plants the idea' and increases risk. Dispelling this myth is foundational to PS12.1 — clinicians who avoid asking will miss the assessment entirely.

Tests application of the structured six-domain assessment sequence. The clinician must correctly sequence the domains — suicidal ideation → intent → plan → means/access → prior attempts → protective factors — and identify the full sequence from a clinical scenario.

Tests analysis of risk factor weighting (prior attempt = strongest predictor) and knowledge of the legal framework — MHCA 2017 Section 115, which decriminalised suicide attempt in India, replacing the 1987 Act.
